Here’s what that happened with the move. Or at least everything I can give without looking like a nutjob. Frankly some things are too bizarre to share.

Some won’t be satisfied by this explanation, and that’s fair enough, but I hope people keep our actual track record in mind. To date on Voat we have banned a whopping two people. It was similar on Reddit. I don’t think anyone would argue that those bans were undeserved. Let’s not turn molehills into mountains and make EviLore comparisons. We berate people like Lore not because he deleted a post that one time, or because he banned someone, but because he has a longstanding record going back years and years, of shitty behavior. We know this community doesn’t take things lying down, and that’s good because it keeps things honest. No one wants to be forced to do anything and we aren't like the sheep of GAF who will accept any ridiculous ToS change that Tyler makes, for example. We’ve seen this community through much worse than a crude test to bring more awareness to our garbage site, which is worse than Reddit, Tumblr, and 4chan combined.

Many know that we’d been playing with the idea of our own domain since the beginning. It certainly started making more and more sense as we were preparing to get banned by Plebbit. Initially I didn’t like the idea because there is an infinite amount of free sites to leech off of, and it’s a pain in the ass getting a site off the ground, especially in our situation.

Side note: I’ve always despised the Reddit layout but eventually got used to it. Voat’s was garbage too but that was pretty much fixed with CSS and they have a dark theme which I like.

We were (rightly) pessimistic about aggregate sites after the Reddit ban, but Voat seemed cool. Yet Voat was always shaky from the very beginning (with the servers breaking and such) and we can only speculate its current status. All I can say is that the things I have read do not read well for Voat’s future. So naturally I started coming around to the idea of a domain. Our destiny would finally be unlinked from these shaky aggregate sites. We don’t have to wait to get banned or wonder where we’re going to be tomorrow. The forum format isn’t perfect by any stretch of the imagination, but it certainly has its perks. I was initially skeptical about Atko. I was pessimistic enough about things that I was a loud criticizer of his, but all things considered I think the Voat people have handled things well, and have said as much before.

For various (obvious) reasons, we knew everything would go completely haywire once we put the redirect up, because we’ve been with this community since the beginning. I personally did not think it would work, but did not consider it impossible. Among other things, I considered the 8chan move and how much people hated it. I personally liked it, but I’ve been a “channer” for very long time so I was used to the format and made a smooth transition. Anyhow, DancingQueen and I went back and forth for days over this recent thing.

That’s why I’m noting my usage of the word “freeze”. We could very easily destroy the sub with a particular function that Voat has that basically makes the place 8chan permanently and anonymizes everything and disables votes. But that would be stupid, and no one wants that. Something that is “frozen” is just that, and can be “thawed” at any point. At best, people are happy to make the move. At worst, Monday evening is a little more thrilling, we all go back to square one, and have a funny story to look back on someday. At least that was the thought. And don't the gaffots themselves deserve a day off from having their asses reddened? I’ll admit, it was a dick move to do it as crudely as we did. Like a bad April Fool’s joke, some will probably stay upset. I can’t know for sure. The idea was to set things up so we could easily revert if things got too crazy, which, predictably, they did. Not to toot my own horn too much but the people here who know me well can speak to my level of foresight and attention to detail.

I’m not gonna lie, while this was all going on I suspected some people complaining were those typical internet types who live for drama (some of who we’re already familiar with) and love feeding on chaos. So when people lost their shit, I couldn’t help but keep that in mind. I didn’t know whether to laugh at someone off their rocker who just loves to stir shit or feel bad for a genuinely concerned member. Some will note that I mentioned we were taking all of the feedback into account. I didn't want people thinking they were being outright ignored, in spite of our actions. Though I did delight in the idea of getting some fag butthurt, who probably doesn't even give a shit about this community and just likes the drama.

The reason DancingQueen and I have avoided certain communities like the plague (and thereby part of the reason this community exists to begin with—there are practically no good options) is because some seem content to have limp-wristed slap fights all day among themselves while they wail at one another like women. Do they want to make fun of spergs or are they spergs themselves? Where do you go if you just want to make fun of this kind of faggotry with cool people, have a laugh and maybe even some good conversation? That’s what’s so great about this community. People like that just get mercilessly ridiculed and promptly run off to their hidey holes.

Anyways, there’s certainly more to this, but that’s the gist of it and I don’t want to drone on any further. If anyone has any questions, feel free to post them here or PM. I can’t guarantee a response since my hands have been pretty full.
